description: Fetch a previously run outward crypto discovery scan by id, including its summary, remediation plan and (optionally) the CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM document or an ML-DSA-65 signed, regulator-admissible report.

include.description: summary (default) = detail; cyclonedx = the CBOM document; report = ML-DSA-65 signed report.

scan_id.description: The scan id returned by run_crypto_scan.

name: get_crypto_scan
